滾動編輯：相鄰片段的編輯點一起移動，總長度不變: Rolling edit: the edit point shared with the neighboring clip moves and the total duration stays the same
片段在序列上開始的影格: The frame where the clip starts in the sequence
片段開始的素材影格: The source frame where the clip starts
片段結束的素材影格（不含這個影格）: The source frame where the clip ends (this frame excluded)
輸入入點或出點時的修剪方式: How typing an in or out point trims
輸入影格數後按 Enter：素材在片段內前後移動，片段的位置和長度不變: Type a number of frames and press Enter: the source moves inside the clip; the clip's position and duration stay the same
入點與出點的修剪方式: How the in and out points trim
「{name}」已啟用；按一下停用（設定會保留）: “{name}” is on; click to turn it off (its settings are kept)
「{name}」已停用；按一下啟用: “{name}” is off; click to turn it on
遮罩裡面變透明，外面保留: Makes the inside of the mask transparent and keeps the outside
節目監看器正在顯示變形控制框；按一下關閉: The Program monitor shows the transform handles; click to hide them
在節目監看器上顯示變形控制框: Show the transform handles in the Program monitor
100 % 是原速；聲音變速不變調: 100 % is the original speed; the sound changes speed without changing pitch
第一個影格停住的影格數；停格期間沒有聲音: Frames the first frame is held; there is no sound during the hold
最後一個影格停住的影格數；停格期間沒有聲音: Frames the last frame is held; there is no sound during the hold
有限動畫：每張畫停留的影格數；聲音不受影響: Limited animation: frames each drawing is held; the sound is not affected
畫面從黑場淡入的影格數: Frames over which the picture fades in from black
畫面淡出到黑場的影格數: Frames over which the picture fades out to black
第 {index} 個，共 {count} 個關鍵影格（每個屬性最多 {limi: Keyframe {index} of {count} (at most {limit} per property); {hidden} more lie outside the range the clip plays
從這個關鍵影格到下一個的變化方式: How the value changes from this keyframe to the next
按一下或拖曳：把播放頭移到片段的這個位置: Click or drag: move the playhead to this position in the clip
把播放頭移到這個片段上，才能設定關鍵影格: Move the playhead onto this clip to set a keyframe
同一個屬性在同一影格只能有一個關鍵影格: A property can have only one keyframe on a frame
{name}：按兩下或按 Enter，套用到「{clip}」的出點: {name}: double-click or press Enter to apply it to the out point of “{clip}”
{name}：按兩下或按 Enter，套用到「{clip}」: {name}: double-click or press Enter to apply it to “{clip}”
先選取時間軸上的片段: Select a clip in the timeline first
目前選取的是轉場；請選取要套用效果的片段: A transition is selected; select the clip to apply the effect to
選取的片段已經有這個效果；在「效果控制」調整: The selected clip already has this effect; adjust it in Effect controls
視訊效果要套用在視訊軌的片段: Video effects apply to clips on a video track
這個編輯點已經是{name}: This edit point already is a {name}
視訊轉場要套用在視訊軌的片段: Video transitions apply to clips on a video track
片段太短，放不下淡化: The clip is too short for the fade
連結的影像會一起轉場；請套用視訊轉場的交叉溶接，聲音會同時交叉淡化: The linked picture would transition too; apply the Cross Dissolve video transition and the sound crossfades with it
匯入影片、聲音或圖片到專案（也可以把檔案拖到這個面板）: Import video, audio or images into the project (you can also drag files onto this panel)
素材庫只能定位上傳的素材；鏡頭的 take 在素材庫的「渲染結果」: The Asset Library can only reveal uploaded media; a shot's takes are under “Renders” in the Asset Library
插入到 {time}，後面的片段往右移: Insert at {time}; the following clips move right
覆寫到 {time}；按住 {key} 改為插入: Overwrite at {time}; hold {key} to insert instead
這個素材已經不在專案裡: This media is no longer in the project
已改用「{name}」較短的新 take: Switched to the shorter new take of “{name}”
改用「{name}」較短的新 take？: Switch to the Shorter New Take of “{name}”?

新 take 長 {duration}。時間軸上用到這個素材的 {count}.one: The new take is {duration} long. The {count} clip that uses this media in the timeline is shortened where it runs past the new media, and the following clips close up. This cannot be undone, and the edit undo history is cleared.
新 take 長 {duration}。時間軸上用到這個素材的 {count}.other: The new take is {duration} long. The {count} clips that use this media in the timeline are shortened where they run past the new media, and the following clips close up. This cannot be undone, and the edit undo history is cleared.

改用這個鏡頭較短的新 take：超出新素材的片段會裁短，後面的片段往前接上，剪輯: Switch to this shot's shorter new take: clips that run past the new media are shortened, the following clips close up, and the edit history starts over; a confirmation comes first
套用較短的新 take 並裁短片段…: Apply the Shorter New Take and Shorten the Clips…
